title: Brotea FinMentor ADS
tagline: Interactive educational platform with AI-driven rewards & blockchain-based sponsored content.
description:
FinMentor Ads is an interactive educational platform that leverages artificial intelligence to deliver incentivized financial education (Web2/Web3) through sponsored NFTs. Companies and blockchain projects bid on educational terms (similar to Google Ads) to teach users about their products and solutions. Users receive economic incentives and NFTs for engaging and learning, increasing user adoption and engagement.

The platform features multi-chain integration across Polygon, Celo, and World Chain, providing instant access through a Mini App embedded within World App, reaching millions of users effortlessly. We utilize Next.js for the ads auction frontend, and Flutter for our mobile app integrated with the OMI wearable for a contextual, real-time educational experience.
how_its_made:
We developed the auction frontend using Next.js, delivering a smooth user experience where companies can bid on educational terms via smart contracts deployed on Polygon, Celo, and World Chain. The Node.js backend manages AI-driven logic, real-time data (via Firebase), and communication with MCP servers feeding contextual insights from the OMI wearable device.

Our mobile app, built with Flutter, offers streamlined wallet management and user authentication through Dynamic SDK, supporting multi-chain transactions and efficient NFT minting on the Celo blockchain. For seamless multi-chain interoperability, we leverage advanced developer tools provided by Nodit (Web3 Data APIs and Webhooks), ensuring a transparent and user-friendly experience for individuals, startups, and blockchain ecosystems.
